zh-CN.summary: WordPress 网站，搭配 MariaDB，并预先建好所有者账号。

zh-TW.summary: WordPress 網站，搭配 MariaDB，並先建好擁有者帳號。

metadata.name: WordPress
metadata.summary: WordPress, with MariaDB and an owner account ready.

zh-CN.summary: WordPress 和 MariaDB 的 Pod 都不用 root 权限运行，并应用严格限制。数据库一律要用 TLS 连接，SQL 账号密码是自动生成的。运算符的辅助镜像，是你使用这个目录时必须信任的一部分。

zh-TW.summary: WordPress 和 MariaDB 的 Pod 都不用 root 權限執行，並套用嚴格限制。資料庫一律要用 TLS 連線，SQL 帳密是自動產生的。運算子的輔助映像檔，是你使用這個目錄時必須信任的一部分。

zh-CN.mitigation: 限制管理员人数，安装插件前先检查，并且持续更新。FastCGI 端口没有对外开放。上传文件夹里不能运行 PHP，wp-config、隐藏文件和原始备份文件的请求也会被挡下来。
zh-CN.risk: WordPress 的插件和主题会运行代码，这些代码碰得到数据库和上传的文件。

zh-TW.mitigation: 限制管理員人數，安裝外掛前先檢查，並且持續更新。FastCGI 連接埠沒有對外開放。上傳資料夾裡不能執行 PHP，wp-config、隱藏檔和原始備份檔的請求也會被擋下來。
zh-TW.risk: WordPress 的外掛和佈景主題會執行程式，這些程式碰得到資料庫和上傳的檔案。

risks.mitigation: Limit who is an administrator, check plugins before you install them and keep them updated. There is no public FastCGI port. PHP cannot run in the uploads folder, and requests for wp-config, hidden files and raw backup files are denied.
risks.risk: WordPress plugins and themes run code that can reach the database and the uploaded files.

zh-CN.mitigation: 网页 Pod 准备好之前，初始化容器（官方的 WP-CLI，用 digest 固定版本）会先用自动生成的密码创建管理员账号。运行过程中不会下载任何东西。
zh-CN.risk: WordPress 还没设置好的时候，第一个打开网站的人就能认领这个网站。

zh-TW.mitigation: 網頁 Pod 準備好之前，初始化容器（官方的 WP-CLI，用 digest 固定版本）會先用自動產生的密碼建立管理員帳號。執行過程中不會下載任何東西。
zh-TW.risk: WordPress 還沒設定好的時候，第一個打開網站的人就能認領這個網站。

risks.mitigation: An init container (official WP-CLI, pinned by digest) creates the admin account with a generated password before the web pods become ready. Nothing is downloaded while it runs.
risks.risk: On a WordPress site that is not set up yet, the first visitor can claim the site.

zh-CN.mitigation: 使用之前，装上目录指定的那个提供者，并固定它的镜像设置。引擎的初始化容器沿用模板的镜像 digest。MaxScale 和 Galera 都没有安装。
zh-CN.risk: MariaDB Operator 会跨命名空间运作，所以你得信任它能管整个集群。

zh-TW.mitigation: 使用之前，裝上目錄指定的那個提供者，並固定它的映像檔設定。引擎的初始化容器沿用範本的映像檔 digest。MaxScale 和 Galera 都沒有安裝。
zh-TW.risk: MariaDB Operator 會跨命名空間運作，所以你得信任它能管整個叢集。

risks.mitigation: Install the exact catalog provider and pin its image settings before you use it. The engine init container uses the template's image digest. MaxScale and Galera are not installed.
risks.risk: The MariaDB Operator works across namespaces, so you have to trust it with the whole cluster.

zh-CN.mitigation: 保留 SQL 机密和 TLS 证书，并且定期演练恢复。先让 WordPress 暂停写入，再把 wordpress-data 卷和机密，跟数据库备份在同一个恢复时间点一起归档。
zh-CN.risk: 数据库备份不含 wordpress-data 卷里的上传文件、插件和主题。

zh-TW.mitigation: 保留 SQL 機密和 TLS 憑證，並且定期演練還原。先讓 WordPress 暫停寫入，再把 wordpress-data 磁碟區和機密，跟資料庫備份在同一個還原時間點一起封存。
zh-TW.risk: 資料庫備份不含 wordpress-data 磁碟區裡的上傳檔案、外掛和佈景主題。

risks.mitigation: Keep the SQL Secrets and the TLS certificates, and run restore drills. Pause WordPress, then archive the wordpress-data volume and the Secrets at the same recovery point as the database.
risks.risk: Database backups do not include the uploads, plugins and themes on the wordpress-data volume.

security.summary: The WordPress and MariaDB pods run without root rights under restricted settings. The database requires TLS, and the SQL credentials are generated. The operator's helper images are part of what you trust when you use this catalog.

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: wordpress-config
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
data:
  nginx.conf: "worker_processes auto;\npid /tmp/nginx.pid;\nerror_log /dev/stderr warn;\nevents { worker_connections\
    \ 1024; }\nhttp {\n  include /etc/nginx/mime.types;\n  default_type application/octet-stream;\n  access_log\
    \ /dev/stdout;\n  client_max_body_size 256m;\n  client_body_temp_path /tmp/client_temp;\n  proxy_temp_path /tmp/proxy_temp;\n\
    \  fastcgi_temp_path /tmp/fastcgi_temp;\n  uwsgi_temp_path /tmp/uwsgi_temp;\n  scgi_temp_path /tmp/scgi_temp;\n\
    \  server {\n    listen 8080;\n    root /var/www/html;\n    index index.php;\n    location = /wp-config.php\
    \ { deny all; }\n    location ~ /\\. { deny all; }\n    location ~* \\.(phar|sql|log|bak)$ { deny all; }\n \
    \   location ~* ^/wp-content/uploads/.*\\.php$ { deny all; }\n    location / { try_files $uri $uri/ /index.php?$args;\
    \ }\n    location ~ \\.php$ {\n      try_files $uri =404;\n      include /etc/nginx/fastcgi_params;\n      fastcgi_param\
    \ SCRIPT_FILENAME $document_root$fastcgi_script_name;\n      fastcgi_param HTTP_PROXY \"\";\n      fastcgi_pass\
    \ 127.0.0.1:9000;\n      fastcgi_read_timeout 300s;\n    }\n  }\n}\n"
  uploads.ini: 'file_uploads=On

    upload_max_filesize=256M

    post_max_size=256M

    memory_limit=1024M

    max_execution_time=300

    '
  database-tls.ini: |
    openssl.cafile=/tmp/database-ca-bundle.pem
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: wordpress-data
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: wordpress
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: wordpress
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        templates.zeabur.com/template: wordpress
        app: wordpress
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 82
        runAsGroup: 82
        fsGroup: 82
        fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
      - name: wordpress
        image: docker.io/wordpress:php8.3-fpm-alpine@sha256:82d93a279778e5307902813c402b9118521e8104459a0e350ed719f6d6c4d1ab
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 1000m
            memory: 1Gi
        volumeMounts: &id001
        - name: html
          mountPath: /var/www/html
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        - name: tools
          mountPath: /tools
        - name: config
          mountPath: /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/uploads.ini
          subPath: uploads.ini
          readOnly: true
        - name: config
          mountPath: /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/database-tls.ini
          subPath: database-tls.ini
          readOnly: true
        - name: database-ca
          mountPath: /database-ca
          readOnly: true
        startupProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 9000
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 120
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 9000
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 3
        livenessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 9000
          periodSeconds: 20
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 6
        env:
        - &id002
          name: WORDPRESS_DB_HOST
          value: mariadb:3306
        - &id003
          name: WORDPRESS_DB_NAME
          value: zeabur
        - &id004
          name: WORDPRESS_DB_USER
          value: wordpress
        - &id005
          name: WORDPRESS_DB_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: wordpress-secrets
              key: database-password
        - &id006
          name: WORDPRESS_CONFIG_EXTRA
          value: define('WP_HOME', 'https://{{ .Domain }}'); define('WP_SITEURL', 'https://{{ .Domain }}'); define('FORCE_SSL_ADMIN',
            true); define('MYSQL_CLIENT_FLAGS', MYSQLI_CLIENT_SSL);
        - &id007
          name: WORDPRESS_AUTH_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: wordpress-secrets
              key: auth-key
        - &id008
          name: WORDPRESS_SECURE_AUTH_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: wordpress-secrets
              key: secure-auth-key
        - &id009
          name: WORDPRESS_LOGGED_IN_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: wordpress-secrets
              key: logged-in-key
        - &id010
          name: WORDPRESS_NONCE_KEY
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: wordpress-secrets
              key: nonce-key
        - &id011
          name: WORDPRESS_AUTH_SALT
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: wordpress-secrets
              key: auth-salt
        - &id012
          name: WORDPRESS_SECURE_AUTH_SALT
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: wordpress-secrets
              key: secure-auth-salt
        - &id013
          name: WORDPRESS_LOGGED_IN_SALT
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: wordpress-secrets
              key: logged-in-salt
        - &id014
          name: WORDPRESS_NONCE_SALT
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: wordpress-secrets
              key: nonce-salt
        - name: PATH
          value: /tools:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
      - name: web
        image: docker.io/nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:stable-alpine@sha256:f5116ed4606f3eb015dd4a8e28cb9b351476dc0ad4bc6e9f93b19cec130cdf03
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault
          runAsUser: 101
          runAsGroup: 101
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 25m
            memory: 64Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 256Mi
        volumeMounts:
        - name: html
          mountPath: /var/www/html
          readOnly: true
        - name: tmp
          mountPath: /tmp
        - name: config
          mountPath: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
          subPath: nginx.conf
          readOnly: true
        ports:
        - name: http
          containerPort: 8080
        startupProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 5
          failureThreshold: 120
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /wp-login.php
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
        livenessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 8080
          periodSeconds: 20
          timeoutSeconds: 3
          failureThreshold: 6
        command:
        - nginx
        - -g
        - daemon off;
      volumes:
      - name: html
        persistentVolumeClaim:
          claimName: wordpress-data
      - name: tmp
        emptyDir:
          sizeLimit: 1Gi
      - name: tools
        emptyDir: {}
      - name: config
        configMap:
          name: wordpress-config
      - name: database-ca
        secret:
          secretName: mariadb-ca
          items:
          - key: ca.crt
            path: ca.crt
      initContainers:
      - name: initialize-wordpress
        image: docker.io/wordpress:php8.3-fpm-alpine@sha256:82d93a279778e5307902813c402b9118521e8104459a0e350ed719f6d6c4d1ab
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 1000m
            memory: 1Gi
        volumeMounts: *id001
        env:
        - *id002
        - *id003
        - *id004
        - *id005
        - *id006
        - *id007
        - *id008
        - *id009
        - *id010
        - *id011
        - *id012
        - *id013
        - *id014
        command:
        - /bin/sh
        - -ec
        - cat /etc/ssl/cert.pem /database-ca/ca.crt > /tmp/database-ca-bundle.pem; exec docker-entrypoint.sh php-fpm -t
      - name: install-owner
        image: docker.io/wordpress:cli-php8.3@sha256:661db880e953da051abcac6c0a769767b995a82cd52101c003ca7438dd427d7d
        securityContext:
          runAsNonRoot: true
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          seccompProfile:
            type: RuntimeDefault
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 100m
            memory: 256Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 1000m
            memory: 1Gi
        volumeMounts: *id001
        env:
        - *id002
        - *id003
        - *id004
        - *id005
        - *id006
        - *id007
        - *id008
        - *id009
        - *id010
        - *id011
        - *id012
        - *id013
        - *id014
        - name: HOME
          value: /tmp
        - name: WP_CLI_CACHE_DIR
          value: /tmp/wp-cli-cache
        - name: WORDPRESS_ADMIN_EMAIL
          value: '{{ .Inputs.adminEmail }}'
        - name: WORDPRESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: wordpress-secrets
              key: admin-password
        command:
        - /bin/sh
        - -ec
        - cp /usr/local/bin/wp /tools/wp; n=0; until wp db check --quiet --ssl --ssl-ca=/database-ca/ca.crt --ssl-verify-server-cert; do n=$((n+1)); [ "$n" -lt 120 ] || exit
          1; sleep 5; done; if ! wp core is-installed; then wp core install --url="https://{{ .Domain }}" --title="WordPress"
          --admin_user=admin --admin_password="$WORDPRESS_ADMIN_PASSWORD" --admin_email="$WORDPRESS_ADMIN_EMAIL"
          --skip-email; fi
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: wordpress
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  selector:
    app: wordpress
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 8080
    targetPort: 8080
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: wordpress
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
  annotations:
    cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: '{{ .ClusterIssuer }}'
    traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/router.entrypoints: websecure
    traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/router.tls: 'true'
spec:
  ingressClassName: traefik
  tls:
  - hosts:
    - '{{ .Domain }}'
    secretName: wordpress-tls
  rules:
  - host: '{{ .Domain }}'
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: wordpress
            port:
              number: 8080
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: mariadb-workload
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
automountServiceAccountToken: false
---
apiVersion: k8s.mariadb.com/v1alpha1
kind: MariaDB
metadata:
  name: mariadb
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  podMetadata:
    labels:
      templates.zeabur.com/template: wordpress
  image: docker.io/mariadb:12.3.3@sha256:4ebbcf100a3ba320766dfa0e1af008df12261301db6ef72798c7650f70794aed
  replicas: 1
  rootPasswordSecretKeyRef:
    name: wordpress-secrets
    key: database-root-password
    generate: false
  serviceAccountName: mariadb-workload
  tls:
    enabled: true
    required: true
  storage:
    size: 10Gi
    pvcRetentionPolicy:
      whenDeleted: Retain
      whenScaled: Retain
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 999
    runAsGroup: 999
    fsGroup: 999
    fsGroupChangePolicy: OnRootMismatch
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault
  securityContext:
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    capabilities:
      drop: [ALL]
  resources:
    requests: {cpu: 100m, memory: 256Mi}
    limits: {cpu: 1000m, memory: 1Gi}
  updateStrategy:
    autoUpdateDataPlane: false
    mariadbAutoUpgradeEnabled: false
---
apiVersion: k8s.mariadb.com/v1alpha1
kind: Database
metadata:
  name: wordpress
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  mariaDbRef: {name: mariadb, waitForIt: true}
  name: zeabur
  characterSet: utf8mb4
  collate: utf8mb4_unicode_ci
  cleanupPolicy: Skip
---
apiVersion: k8s.mariadb.com/v1alpha1
kind: User
metadata:
  name: wordpress
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  mariaDbRef: {name: mariadb, waitForIt: true}
  name: wordpress
  host: '%'
  passwordSecretKeyRef:
    name: wordpress-secrets
    key: database-password
  require: {ssl: true}
  maxUserConnections: 30
  cleanupPolicy: Skip
---
apiVersion: k8s.mariadb.com/v1alpha1
kind: Grant
metadata:
  name: wordpress
  namespace: '{{ .Namespace }}'
spec:
  mariaDbRef: {name: mariadb, waitForIt: true}
  username: wordpress
  host: '%'
  database: zeabur
  table: '*'
  privileges: [SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE, DROP, ALTER, INDEX]
  grantOption: false
  cleanupPolicy: Skip
